value.data: Marathahalli metro station (Blue Line Phase 2A) is under construction and expected to open in June 2026. The nearest operational metro stations are Seetharampalya (approx. 2.61 km) and Kundalahalli (approx. 2.66 km) on the Purple Line. Whitefield (Kadugodi) metro station on the Purple Line is operational.

The Marathahalli-Whitefield Road experiences heavy traffic congestion daily, especially during peak hours. Recent traffic changes at Marathahalli Bridge have been observed to shift congestion rather than reduce it.

Major upcoming infrastructure projects include the Marathahalli metro station (expected by June 2026), Kundalahalli Flyover (expected late 2025 or early 2026), and Varthur Road Widening. Other projects include the Bengaluru Suburban Rail (Kengeri to Whitefield line by 2028), Peripheral Ring Road (PRR), Satellite Town Ring Road (STRR), a proposed 40 km tunnel road network, and Outer Ring Road (ORR) corridor development.

Marathahalli-Whitefield Road is a dynamic and densely populated residential area in East Bengaluru, highly sought after by IT professionals and families due to its proximity to major tech hubs and a wide range of amenities. The area is undergoing significant infrastructure development, including metro expansion and road projects, which are expected to enhance connectivity and property values. However, residents frequently face challenges with heavy traffic congestion and a high risk of waterlogging during heavy rains.
Densely populated, vibrant, active, and a busy hub with a mix of established and new residential developments, attracting IT professionals and families.

Frequent waterlogging is a serious issue in Marathahalli and Whitefield, particularly in areas near lakes and during the monsoon season. Incidents include waterlogging at the newly inaugurated Nallurhalli metro station and major flooding in parts of Whitefield, HSR Layout, Outer Ring Road (ORR), Siddapura, and Panathur underbridge.
